rationale: A coherent conjunction of the two strongest gen-1 legs whose incremental value is a real question (level vs. flow complementarity), though the second leg — negative growth in non-cash current assets — is close to the textbook working-capital accrual/asset-growth anomaly, so any alpha may be largely borrowed rather than new.

The name and stated purpose promise a multiplicative DuPont decomposition that would identify which component carries the information, but MIN of the two component ranks is neither a decomposition nor a test of that question, and since margin × turnover mechanically equals the gen-1 winner GP/(act−che), the conjunction is a near-mechanical variant of an already-evaluated signal.

A sensible, high-coverage stock-based repair of the failed apalch flow signal, but the long leg (high profitability, low operating liabilities) tilts toward high net operating assets and thus points against the well-documented NOA/operating-liability-leverage evidence, so the expected positive sign is economically contestable and should be defended or flipped.

The first difference of log-like GP/(act−che) is approximately gross-profit growth minus working-capital-base growth, which is essentially the already-evaluated ProfitGrowthVsAccrualBaseGrowth signal in level-difference form, so this is a cosmetic re-parameterization with added noise from a small, sign-unstable denominator.

Conditioning margin on the second moment of the operating-cycle ratio is a genuinely distinct mechanism relative to everything in the archive, though it sits close to the Dechow-Dichev/accrual-quality and earnings-volatility literature and the 5-year window will bias the sample toward long-lived survivors, so coverage and composition stability must be checked before crediting any alpha.

Corroborating profits against the cash stock is a cheap, high-coverage alternative to the failed cash-flow-statement legs, but Δche/at is heavily confounded by financing (issuance, debt draws) and by underinvestment, so the leg is a noisy proxy for "profits arrived in cash" and the interpretation of any result will be ambiguous.
